flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper} (DN2/DR3 reminder query, exclusion list, DataHive contact refresh, combineNotices, batch SMS), framework/schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil, framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/helpers/ToppanUploadHelper (stage DN2 -> DR3), framework/workflows/agencies/mha/{upload,download} (particulars check), utilities/suspension_helpers/SuspensionBaseHelper, framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService. ocmsadminapi operational/cronproxy/CronProxyService (manual trigger). ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no driver reminder code
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark: Vault Code Split (Vault must run because the notice needs vehicle and owner info; Vault permission for the App Service: cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck, so 'Sesuai' means the code follows the story text. The contact check before the electronic reminder is done by NotificationSmsEmailJob and matches OCMS12.8/OCMS12.18 for other stages; for drivers the reminder query covers last stage DN2 and DR3 through the offender_indicator = 'Y' join. Gaps: (1) the number refresh from DataHive is off (cron.enareminder.datahive=false in dev/UAT/PROD), so only the stored number is used and no new number is saved; (2) the whole eNotification job is switched off (cron.notification.enabled=false in dev/UAT/PROD) and only runs through the manual trigger; (3) the DN2 template content (whether it refers to the 2nd letter) is in the DB, not in the repo; (4) a company driver gets nothing because the DN2 email is skipped. 'DOS' does not appear in the code; DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Tickets used: OCMS-DF-2026-180.
recommendation: Claim partially (70%). The candidate selection and contact filtering for DN2 exist, but the DataHive number refresh and the eNotification job are switched off in every environment. Enable both in UAT, show one DN2 notice whose number was updated from DataHive and then entered the reminder batch, and show the DN2 template in PROD.

steps.step: After the 2nd letter is processed, the driver notice at stage DN2 becomes a candidate for the electronic reminder
steps.detail: The DN2 letter moves last_processing_stage to DN2 (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1296-1306). The eNotification job takes notices with last_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3) joined to the owner_driver row with offender_indicator = 'Y' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1110-1114), so driver notices at DN2 are included. The due date (last_processing_date + POS + PDD) must be <= today + ENOTEDAYS, and only notices without suspension or with TS-HST are taken (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1115-1121); the job marks nextProcessingStage with this stage (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:161-162, 174-179). The ENOTEDAYS join is not a LEFT JOIN (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1107-1109), so a parameter row for DN2 must exist in the DB; the POS, PDD and ENOTEDAYS values: cannot verify from repo. Note: the DN2 stage can advance even when the file never reached Toppan (see OCMS12.41).

steps.step: OCMS checks the driver's latest mobile number from DOS (DataHive/Singpass)
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and then refreshContactInfo per record (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-187). Individuals are checked against DataHive Singpass through refreshIndividualContactInfo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2716), but the whole refresh only runs when cron.enareminder.datahive = true (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:92-93, 2325-2332, 2468-2477) and the value is false in dev, UAT and PROD (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48), so only the number already stored on the record is used. The word 'DOS' does not appear in the code; DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Vault/DataHive access from the App Service: cannot verify from repo. Same fit as the contact-check steps in OCMS12.8, OCMS12.9 and OCMS12.18.

steps.step: The latest mobile number is saved to the driver's data on the notice
steps.detail: When the DataHive path is active, updateOcmsContactInfo patches offender_tel_no and email_addr in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver per noticeNo + idNo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2756-2764, 2800-2822). Because the cron.enareminder.datahive flag is false in every environment (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2468-2477 returns early), this update does not run on the eNotification path. Same fit as the contact-saving step in OCMS12.18.

steps.step: A driver without a valid mobile number is skipped and gets no reminder
steps.detail: validateContactInfo rejects records with a contactError and individuals without phoneNo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2288). In the job, an invalid non-ENA record is skipped with a log and does not enter the batch (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:254-266). So a reminder is only prepared when a number exists, as the story intends. Completeness of numbers in the DB: cannot verify from repo. One note: a company driver (id type B) can only get email, and the email for DN2 is skipped because no template exists (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:311-316), so a company driver gets no reminder; this story only concerns the mobile number.

steps.step: A driver with a valid number goes to the electronic reminder SMS batch that refers to the 2nd letter, and the eNotification job runs
steps.detail: An individual with a valid number enters smsRecords (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:274-283) and is sent through sendBatchSms (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:289-291). The template is named <stage>_<channel>_<recipient>, so for DN2 DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL or DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL_COMBINED is used (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:459-476); whether the text refers to the 2nd letter is in the template content in the DB and not in the repo: cannot verify from repo. The actual sending is the scope of OCMS12.43. Partial because the scheduler skips execution when cron.notification.enabled=false (NotificationJobsScheduler.java:30-31, 48-52) and the value is false in dev, UAT and PROD (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236); the check only runs through the manual trigger POST /notification-sms-email/execute (CronProxyService.java:203). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed) notes 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate' and confirms the DN2/DR3 reminder stages are unchanged so the due date matches the letter.
